model_settings.value: Voxel-based PCA applied to 70 FDG-PET images, each containing 200,668 voxels; images were centered by removing the mean and scaled by square root of n−1. Images were globally mean scaled, spatially normalized to the MNI template, smoothed with a 12 mm FWHM isotropic kernel, and analyzed using SPM2 in MATLAB. The first three principal components were retained for description; significance was assessed at P<0.05 using random field theory correction for multiple comparisons, with Bonferroni correction also examined.
